pages.text: $(italic)Modular armor in the Tetra style.$()$(br2)Iridescent Reforging brings Tetra's module-and-honing framework to the armor slot. Drop any armor (vanilla iron, ISS Cultist Hood, Aether Phoenix, Aquaculture diving helmet, etc.) into a Tetra workbench's input slot and it becomes a Reforged variant — modular, hone-able, and ready for upgrades.$(br2)Specialized armor keeps its identity. Vanilla armor gets the modular shape with a default-tier module pre-installed.

pages.title: How to reforge
pages.text: $(bold)Drop in the Tetra workbench.$()$(br2)Place the source armor in the workbench input slot. The replacement happens automatically.$(br2)$(bold)Specialized armor keeps its identity:$() the source's school spell power, set bonus, Apotheosis affixes, and enchantments all carry through. Visual model preserved (ISS via Geckolib; others via the source mod's vanilla armor texture).$(br2)$(bold)Vanilla iron/gold/diamond/netherite$() get the modular shape with a default-tier module pre-installed (iron variant) — upgrade at the workbench.

pages.title: Module slots
pages.text: Each reforged piece has 2 slots:$(br2)$(thing)Helmet$() — crown (major) + visor (minor)$(br)$(thing)Chestplate$() — chest_plate (major) + chest_lining (minor)$(br)$(thing)Leggings$() — leg_plate (major) + belt (minor)$(br)$(thing)Boots$() — boot_sole (major) + boot_lining (minor)$(br2)Major slots take metal materials and provide armor scaling with metal tier. Minor slots take fabric/leather/fibre (generic utility) OR themed materials (identity-flavored bonuses).

pages.title: Major slot bonuses (armor scaling)
pages.text: $(bold)Crown / chest_plate / leg_plate / boot_sole$() — apply a metal, armor scales with the metal's tier.$(br2)$(thing)iron$() — modest baseline$(br)$(thing)gold$() — low armor, more enchantability$(br)$(thing)diamond$() — solid mid-tier$(br)$(thing)netherite$() — top vanilla tier$(br2)Modded metals (manasteel, knightmetal, ignitium, etc.) plug into Tetra's $(thing)tetra:metal/$() category automatically when their mod registers them. Higher-tier modded metals give correspondingly higher armor.

pages.title: Minor slot bonuses — generic
pages.text: Apply $(thing)wool / string / leather$() (anything in $(thing)tetra:fabric/$(), $(thing)tetra:fibre/$(), or $(thing)tetra:skin/$()) for the baseline utility:$(br2)$(thing)visor$() — +0.5 armor$(br)$(thing)chest_lining$() — +5%% mana regen$(br)$(thing)belt$() — +2%% knockback resistance$(br)$(thing)boot_lining$() — +0.2%% movement speed$(br2)Cheap entry-level option. Players upgrade to themed materials later for identity bonuses.

pages.title: Minor slot bonuses — themed
pages.text: Apply axis-themed materials for identity-flavored bonuses. The 8 axes:$(br2)$(thing)Fire$() — blaze rod$(br)$(thing)Ice$() — blue ice$(br)$(thing)Shadow$() — ghast tear$(br)$(thing)Holy$() — glowstone dust$(br)$(thing)Lightning$() — redstone$(br)$(thing)Nature$() — sapling (gives mana regen instead of school)$(br)$(thing)Ender$() — ender pearl$(br)$(thing)Blood$() — rotten flesh$(br2)Each theme grants $(item)+5%% school spell power$() on the visor, $(item)+4%%$() + mana regen on chest lining, $(item)+3%%$() + KB resist on belt, $(item)+3%%$() + speed on boot lining.

pages.title: Stack identity bonuses
pages.text: Themed minors stack with specialized skin attributes — that's the design.$(br2)$(thing)Cultist Hood$() (skin gives +5%% blood spell power) + $(thing)Shadow visor$() (+5%% blood) → $(item)+10%% blood spell power$() on the helmet.$(br2)$(thing)Phoenix Robe$() (no school natively but fire-themed) + $(thing)Fire lining$() → $(item)+4%% fire spell power$() + $(item)+4%% mana regen$() added to the chestplate.$(br2)Mixing axes is allowed but suboptimal — a Cultist Hood with an $(thing)Ice visor$() gets ice spell power on a hood whose skin gives blood. The codex doesn't enforce, players self-police.

pages.title: Honing
pages.text: Each slot has a 5-level honing track scaling its signature stat:$(br2)$(thing)Helmet$() — armor toughness (+0.5 to +3.0)$(br)$(thing)Chestplate$() — armor (+0.5 to +3.0)$(br)$(thing)Leggings$() — knockback resistance (+0.02 to +0.10)$(br)$(thing)Boots$() — movement speed (+0.001 to +0.005)$(br2)Hone with the same hammer tiers as spellbooks: gold (L1), iron (L2), steel (L3), diamond (L4), netherite (L5).$(br2)At L3 you can apply the $(bold)settled$() schematic to lock the slot's identity and gain a small cross-stat bonus.

pages.title: Specialized skin coverage
pages.text: $(bold)v0.4 covers 42+ sets$() across ISS, Aether, Twilight Forest, Cataclysm, Aquaculture, Forbidden Arcanus, Undergarden, Deeperdarker, Botania, Blue Skies, Deep Aether.$(br2)Each set's signature attributes — armor, toughness, Spell Power, school-specific Spell Power (fire/ice/lightning/etc.) — carry through to the reforged version. The Geckolib visual model is preserved for ISS armors; vanilla armor textures route through the source mod's existing texture path for non-Geckolib sets.$(br2)Theabyss elemental sets, Aethersteel, and Alex's Mobs single-slot specialty pieces land in v0.4.x.

pages.title: Set bonuses
pages.text: $(bold)Set bonuses persist through reforging.$()$(br2)When you wear 4 reforged pieces all sharing the same set identity (e.g. 4 reforged Phoenix pieces), the original full-set bonus fires automatically.$(br2)Examples:$(br)$(thing)Phoenix$() — fire immunity$(br)$(thing)Neptune$() — water breathing + dolphin's grace$(br)$(thing)Aquaculture Neptunium$() — water breathing$(br)$(thing)Yeti$() — strength$(br)$(thing)Gravitite$() — jump boost II$(br)$(thing)Ignitium / Fiery$() — fire immunity$(br2)Mixed sets (Phoenix helmet + Cultist chestplate + ...) lose set bonuses — the per-piece base attributes still apply.
